{"heading":"Caregiving can change every part of life.
You shouldn't have to navigate it alone.","paragraph":"Caring for someone living with dementia can change every part of life. As needs evolve, caregivers often find themselves navigating new roles, responsibilities, and decisions while trying to care for themselves, too. Caregiver Sanctuary provides respite, wellness, practical support, and community to help caregivers feel supported throughout the journey."}
